tagline: A 3-minute reading check that shows each child's real level and what to do next.
pendingUploads_one: {{count}} reading check waiting to be sent
pendingUploads_other: {{count}} reading checks waiting to be sent

login.title: Teacher login
login.unreachable: Can't reach the LevelOS server. Check the internet connection and try again.
login.serverError: The server had a problem. Please try again in a minute.
login.waking: Waking up the server — the first login can take up to a minute.

signup.title: Create a teacher account
signup.name: Your name
signup.have: Already have a login ID? Log in
signup.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
signup.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Log in with its login ID.
signup.pinDigits: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits.
signup.note: Write it down. You will log in with this ID and your PIN.

classes.title: My classes
classes.name: Class name
classes.languageHint: The language the children learn to read in. The English reading test is always there too.
classes.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its children and their reading checks are deleted too. This cannot be undone.

dashboard.groupsHint: Children grouped by reading level. A dotted border means the level is not yet confirmed by a second check.
dashboard.pendingReview_one: 1 reading check is waiting for your confirmation. Tap the child to open it.
dashboard.pendingReview_other: {{count}} reading checks are waiting for your confirmation. Tap a child to open it.

student.provisionalHelp: A level is confirmed when two reading checks in a row agree.
student.groupStart: The reading check gives only this group's card ({{level}}); no other level.
student.autoStart: The reading check starts at the child's last level; a child not checked yet starts at letters.

checkin.showChild: Show the phone to the child. Tap the microphone when they are ready.
checkin.recording: Recording… tap stop when the child finishes

rerecord.too_short: That was too short. Please record again.
rerecord.silent: We could not hear the child. Move the phone closer and record again.
rerecord.too_long: The recording was too long. Please record again.
rerecord.wrong_item: That sounded like a different text. Make sure the child reads this card, and record again.
rerecord.bad_audio: The recording could not be read. Please record again.

checkin.failed: Could not check this recording now. Mark it by tapping instead.
checkin.markHelp: Tap every letter or word the child read wrongly, then save.
checkin.confirmHelp: We are not sure about these. Listen to the recording, then mark each one.
checkin.stopConfirm: Stop this check? Nothing is saved for this child.
checkin.micPermission: Microphone permission is needed. Allow it in the browser and try again.
checkin.micUnsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Use Chrome on Android.
checkin.notPlaced: These cards do not give a level (skipped cards do not count). Choose the level yourself, or stop the check.

result.provisionalNote: First result at this level. It is confirmed when the next check agrees.
result.confirmedNote: Confirmed: two checks in a row agree.
result.updating: A detailed analysis is on its way…
result.tapWord: Tap a word to correct it.
result.markedAndChecked: Marked by tapping, then checked by AI
result.deleteConfirm: Delete the recordings of this reading check? The marks stay.
result.keptDays: Recordings are kept for {{days}} days so you can listen again, then deleted.

activity.title: 10-minute activity
activity.generating: Preparing an activity for this group…
activity.generatingLmStudio: Creating the activity with LM Studio on this computer…
activity.readAloud: The teacher says this rhyme aloud (the children do not read it)
activity.showRhyme: Show the rhyme for the teacher ({{title}})

hint.chain: Tap Next to change one vowel sign or vowel. A child reads the new word and says what changed.
hint.pairs: Say the letter aloud; a child taps it.
hint.build: Children tap the cards in order to build the word.
hint.flash: Each word shows for a moment. ✓ when the group reads it; ↻ to see it again later.
hint.chart: Tap a cell, or play a row, column, diagonal or zig-zag from it.
hint.findwrong: Children read word by word and tap the wrong word.
hint.rhyme: Play the rhyme line by line and point at the words; then say a word and a child taps it.
hint.match: Tap a word, then its picture.
hint.text: Read the rhyme together, pointing at the words; then say a word and a child taps it.
hint.story: Children read a sentence each; then open the questions and let a child point to the line with the answer.
hint.hunt: Say the letter shown; children tap every word in the rhyme that starts with it.
hint.letters: Say the sound of the hidden letter; a child taps every place it is written.

meaning.title: Meaning
meaning.help: Say the word; tap the picture the child points to.

offlineCheck.banner: No network: this check is saved on the phone and sent when you are back online.
offlineCheck.recordThenMark: Record the child reading, then mark it.
offlineCheck.recorded: Recorded. Now tap every letter or word read wrongly.
offlineCheck.markNow: Tap every letter or word read wrongly.
offlineCheck.provisional: Level from your marks (not yet confirmed)
offlineCheck.savedNote: Saved on this phone. It will be sent and checked by AI as soon as there is network.
offlineCheck.synced: Sent. The AI check is on the child's page.
offlineCheck.failed: Could not be sent yet. It will be tried again.

errors.offline: No network. Check the connection and try again.
errors.notFound: This could not be found. It may have been removed.
errors.tooLong: The recording is too long. Please record again.
errors.confirmFirst: First confirm the words the app was not sure about.
errors.nothingRead: No card has been read yet.
errors.checkMoved: This reading check has moved on. Go back to the child's page and open it again.
